target_platform.note: Reference only. Record actual test machine build; do not assume it matches this value.

tasks.delivery: implementation PR based on current main
tasks.title: Enforce CAMPAIGN_START_V1 before the first external request
tasks.finding: The current capture CLI accepts --source-config and optional --rpc-profiles, creates a runtime manifest, then opens governed transport. The V2 preflight docs say CS-01..CS-10 are mapped manually and no script executes the gate.
actions: Map every blocking CS-01..CS-10 item to an existing code owner and exact pre-network check.
Resolve current canonical human/release authorization mechanism before adding code; inspect src/release_gate/, src/runtime_authority.py and src/provider_governance/.
Require explicit authorization bound to exact approved manifest digest, code/release SHA, source config/generations, RPC profiles, policy, budget, retention and capture window.
Run all blocking checks before constructing/opening external transport or making DNS/network calls.
If canonical operator approval cannot be verified by existing infrastructure, return typed BLOCKED and do not invent an unsigned boolean/string approval that pretends to be authorization.
acceptance: Missing or invalid operator authorization -> typed BLOCKED and instrumented zero physical network attempts.
Changed profile/config/budget/runtime SHA after approval -> typed BLOCKED and zero network attempts.
All CS gates have explicit status, evidence reference, owner and typed blocker.
No CAPTURE_ONLY campaign is executed while implementing this task.

tasks.title: Separate campaign label, cryptographic identity and authorization envelope
tasks.finding: V2 uses a human-readable campaign_id while CampaignManifest.campaign_id is a canonical digest. V2 release.git_commit records ea204222..., older than current main 0a0c8ad9...; campaign_manifest_sha256 is null at authoring time.
actions: Rename the human-readable identifier to campaign_label/campaign_ref and keep CampaignManifest.campaign_id exclusively as cryptographic identity.
Avoid circular self-hash. Use an existing detached approval envelope bound to canonical manifest digest; if no canonical approval owner exists, remain BLOCKED.
Compare actual runtime CampaignManifest to the exact approved manifest before network.
Resolve code SHA dynamically according to release authority; do not hardcode this task's main SHA into runtime code.
Preserve provenance from template -> V1 -> V2 -> approved digest -> runtime campaign identity -> journal/report.
acceptance: A changed manifest or profile produces a different digest and invalidates approval.
Tests cover tampered manifest, missing digest, stale code SHA and dirty checkout.
No null/self-referential identity is ever treated as bound.

tasks.title: Reconcile V2, source catalog, actual adapters and current docs pins
tasks.finding: representative-sources.json has three entries and old 2026-10-06 checked_at values with 86400-second TTL. V2 source names differ from DiscoveryRequest canonical IDs; Meteora adapter is not represented in the current sample config.
actions: Build a four-way crosswalk: manifest id, catalog id, DiscoveryRequest id and adapter id.
Use actual supported IDs for DexScreener, GeckoTerminal, Raydium and Meteora DLMM; aliases require explicit registry mapping plus tests.
Re-fetch official docs, exact route, terms, limits and schema; update checked_at, SHA256, schema fingerprint and provider quota.
Keep all four in discovery-only classification; no indexed metadata becomes an exact edge.
If current docs/terms are inaccessible, status remains typed BLOCKED; do not keep expired pins.
acceptance: All configured source dossiers pass current TTL and schema validation.
Manifest source generations exactly equal the runtime profiles and adapters loaded by CLI.
Positive and negative tests cover alias mapping, stale pin, redirect, 429 and schema drift.

tasks.title: Enforce durable campaign-global physical-attempt and storage budgets
tasks.finding: CampaignEvidenceStore currently exposes per-profile attempt accounting. V2 proposes a global cap of 200 and 100 MiB storage. Verify and enforce both across the entire campaign, all profiles, retries, SQLite files and blob storage.
actions: Keep independent per-provider quotas and add a separate atomic durable campaign-global counter for all physical attempts.
Retries/backoff count as physical attempts; restarts, replay and multi-process workers never reset or double-spend counters.
Enforce the approved total storage ceiling across journal DB, WAL/SHM, raw blobs and temp/staging files.
Fail closed before a network attempt or write if quota/storage usage is unknown or exhausted.
Keep external_data_spend_usd_max=0 and reject paid provider entitlements.
acceptance: Two providers each at 100 cannot exceed campaign-global 200; test concurrency and restart.
Retry counts increment physical attempt count.
Storage usage at the exact limit passes; one byte over fails before persist.
Budget receipts survive process restart and offline replay.

tasks.title: Align sender-free RPC methods between actual runtime and connections registry
tasks.finding: ProviderProfile.READ_RPC_METHODS and the MPR2602 connections-registry enum differ. rpc.py calls getVersion, getSlot and collectors perform rooted account reads; template contains getGenesisHash/getMultipleAccounts/getSlot/getBlockHeight only.
actions: Enumerate actual methods called by each collector on capture path.
Compare to both registry enums and ensure the intersection supports the exact required read methods.
Do not add unused getBlock/getBlockHeight or unsafe methods just to make schemas match.
Keep every profile disabled/unreviewed until real operator review; maintain 0 network effects in structural validator.
acceptance: A test proves every actual RPC method is explicitly allowed by both relevant registries.
A test proves an unlisted method is rejected before transport.
Sender/submission methods remain impossible.

tasks.title: Fix runbook capture/replay cross-reference and add the actual CLI capture section
tasks.finding: #671 remaining-blockers list points to runbook S7 for capture, but S7 is Deterministic offline replay.
actions: Add an explicit capture section with exact CLI flags, source config, approved manifest/approval input, RPC profiles, output directory and expected typed outcomes.
Document that replay is offline only and not a capture operation.
Document Windows PowerShell command syntax without exposing secrets.
acceptance: No runbook step points users to replay as the capture command.
All commands match actual CLI parser flags and tests.

tasks.title: Regenerate requirements.lock with Windows uvloop marker
tasks.finding: pyproject.toml declares uvloop==0.22.1 only when platform_system != Windows, but requirements.lock has unmarked uvloop==0.22.1. #670 package_smoke wheelhouse failed on Windows because no Windows wheel exists.
actions: Use scripts/lock_requirements.py with pinned uv 0.13.4 to regenerate the lock; do not hand-edit the generated file.
Preserve uvloop for supported Unix targets, exclude it on Windows through the correct marker.
Check all hashes and verify lock generation is deterministic.
acceptance: Native Windows pip download/install using --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: succeeds.
Linux installs still include uvloop and pass.
Repeated lock generation gives no unexplained diff.

tasks.title: Fix ProactorEventLoop + pytest-socket without opening network access
tasks.finding: #670 shows 327 fixture setup errors from pytest_socket.SocketBlockedError when Windows ProactorEventLoop creates an AF_INET socketpair/self-pipe; --allow-unix-socket covers AF_UNIX only.
actions: Reproduce on clean Windows 11 26H2 x64 with Python 3.13.
Use targeted event-loop bootstrap/loopback allowance only; never remove --disable-socket globally.
Add tests proving Proactor loop starts and external DNS/TCP/UDP stays blocked.
Retain Linux SelectorEventLoop regression tests.
acceptance: All asyncio fixtures collect and execute on Windows.
External outbound socket attempts remain blocked.
Network-denial regression test fails if a public host can be reached.
Linux CI remains green.

tasks.title: Close SQLite and journal handles before TemporaryDirectory cleanup
tasks.finding: #670 verify_occ_durable_host failed with PermissionError WinError 32 on content.sqlite3 under TemporaryDirectory.
actions: Reproduce the open handle on Windows and identify whether sqlite connection, WAL/SHM, journal or authority remains open.
Add explicit close/context-manager lifecycle; close all databases before cleanup.
Do not use ignore_errors=True or suppress PermissionError.
acceptance: Temporary directory deletion succeeds immediately after context exit.
Regression test runs on Windows and Linux.
No leaked SQLite handles remain after repeated verifier runs.

tasks.title: Add native Windows verification and rerun post-fix pytest baseline
tasks.finding: #670 labels the platform Windows 10.0.26300; that OS version string should be identified as Windows 11 26H2 when verified via Caption/DisplayVersion. The Windows suite is explicitly NOT green.
actions: Add a Windows CI job where supported and provide a native Windows 11 26H2 PowerShell receipt; GitHub-hosted Windows runner is supplementary, not equivalent to a Windows 11 client.
Record OS Caption, DisplayVersion, build, architecture, Python exact version, PowerShell, uv, Git and core.autocrlf.
After WIN-02, rerun the entire offline suite; do not carry forward old counts.
Triage genuine remaining test IDs into focused PRs with explicit root cause.
acceptance: All required verify_repo stages complete on native Windows or remain explicitly BLOCKED with owner.
Receipt contains exact commit and SHA256.
No old 288/327 totals are presented as current without a fresh rerun.

tasks.title: Repair the two GitHub CI failures in #665
tasks.finding: At checked head 548d5c06, GitHub scripts/verify_pmm_sim_caller_profile.py reports 15/17. vendor_mirror_sha256sums fails for .github/workflows/audit.yml, .github/workflows/ci.yml and .gitignore; results_digest_chain fails because CSV digest does not match scenario_manifest receipt.
actions: Reproduce on clean Linux and Windows checkouts of the exact head.
Find actual cause (bytes/line endings, checksum generation, stale manifest or generated data); do not guess.
Regenerate mirror hashes from committed bytes and correct manifest/CSV receipt.
Add a checkout-independent regression test and rerun every required workflow on updated #665 head.
acceptance: Verifier is 17/17 on both clean OS checkouts.
GitHub CI required jobs PASS on exact current head.
Summary report matches committed receipts.

tasks.title: Review the size/retention cost of #665 evidence
tasks.finding: #665 currently has 691 changed files, including hundreds of JSONL evidence journals, snapshots, result files and binary fixtures.
actions: Measure actual repository and checkout size.
Keep integrity/provenance evidence; never delete evidence merely to reduce diff.
Evaluate existing approved artifact registry/storage and retention mechanisms before moving large files.
If no approved immutable storage exists, keep artifacts tracked and document the storage cost.
acceptance: Every moved artifact has immutable digest, retrieval procedure and retention owner.
No evidence is silently dropped.

tasks.title: Triage genuine failures after Proactor fixture errors are removed
tasks.finding: #670 baseline lists GPR=146 failed tests, other=119, QPR=21 and 327 fixture errors; another report cites unresolved synthetic path in registry.py. Existing counts are historical and must be reproduced.
actions: Rerun after WIN-02 and classify by exact current failing test and first root-cause traceback.
Reproduce on a clean main checkout to distinguish real main debt from PR regressions.
Fix unresolved synthetic path and other confirmed errors under the owning module; add smallest regression test.
Create one focused PR per root cause/module owner; do not combine unrelated GPR, TON and MPR2602 changes.
acceptance: No aggregate failure count without current commit/test IDs.
Every genuine failure has owner, fix/typed blocker, and regression test.

safety_invariants: No CAPTURE_ONLY execution as part of task-pack or implementation PR.
No signing, sending, borrowing, account creation, relay submission or tips.
No paid provider activation or credential probing.
No live gate weakening or synthetic data promoted to real evidence.
Missing approvals/unknown quotas/source semantics fail closed.
